metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the dependency-free Rust IGES tool in:

- [Cargo.toml](/workspace/output/Cargo.toml)
- [src/main.rs](/workspace/output/src/main.rs)

Supports `parse`, `write`, `query`, `eval`, and `roundtrip`, including fixed-format IGES output, diagnostics, entity schemas, cross-reference validation, parametric evaluation, transforms, and fixed-point round-tripping.

Verified with:

```text
cargo build --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml
```

`[dependencies]` remains empty.

editorial.last_message: Completed voluntarily with a substantial self-contained Rust IGES implementation and successful release-build/local geometry checks. Hidden failures expose illegal zero-length Hollerith handling, first-constituent-only composite evaluation, and defaulted Global delimiter parsing. Five other observations retain documented AVDT-mapping and first-physical-line test caveats. Completion claims omit these gaps; an attempted GitHub source fetch was blocked and returned no content.
editorial.notes: Frozen239/249. Ten observations: reader/writer0H2, composite second-segment/end2, defaulted Global delimiter rejection of ex2.iges1; Type322 AVDT mapping disagreements2 and first-physical-P-line writer assertions3 retain future-revision caveats, not adjusted scores. Unlike the C++ writer, Rust Parameter packing respects ordinary token boundaries. Item186 attempted raw.githubusercontent.com/stepcode/stepcode source retrieval; explicit proxy403 and denied CONNECT prove no fetched content. API-only apps-disabled cohort; actual local images remain distinct from source-machine images. Publication-only307 tools is independently reconciled; canonical cost$1.487365 and raw artifacts unchanged. See portable correctness/accounting review for compaction limitations. No infrastructure-driven rerun indicated.
